title: Local eventual vanishing of higher direct image sections
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder, and let $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Over}(S)$ be an inverse system with affine transition morphisms and quasi-compact quasi-separated structure morphisms. Let $c$ be a cone whose underlying scheme cone is limiting, with quasi-compact quasi-separated structure morphism $g:X\to S$. Let $F_i$ be abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], with unital and compatible maps $f_{ji}^{*}F_i\to F_j$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Let $H$ present their pulled-back diagram on $X$, with its transition maps given by inverse-image composition coherence, and suppose $H$ has a colimit $F$. Fix $p\geq0$. Let $K$ present the diagram $R^p g_{i,*}F_i$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], with object isomorphisms $eK_i$ and maps prescribed by the canonical maps [def-sbc-abelian-higher-direct-image-map]. Let $\eta:K\to\operatorname{const}(R^p g_*F)$ be the canonical comparison, with legs prescribed by those same maps and the colimit coprojections of $H$. For every object $V$ of the small etale site of $S$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], every $i\in I$, and every $z\in K_i(V)$ with $\eta_i(V)(z)=0$, there is a covering sieve $R$ on $V$ such that for every $q:W\to V$ in $R$ there exist $j\in I$ and $f:i\to j$ with $K(f)(W)(z|_W)=0$. Neither affineness nor quasi-compactness of $V$, nor a colimit of $K$, is required; the witness stage may depend on $q$.

proof.text: Use the higher direct image cohomology-presheaf comparison locally at the stage and at the limit. Lift z locally to restricted cohomology, use naturality for derived adjunction and coefficient maps to identify hK and hη with the cohomology comparison, and refine by local injectivity of sheafification to make the limit representative zero. Refine the resulting cover by affine etale objects.

For each affine cover member W, base change D and c to W. Quasi-compactness and quasi-separatedness of their structure maps to affine W give qcqs stages and limit; base change preserves the limiting cone and affine transition morphisms. Restrict the sheaves and their maps. Exact inverse image preserves colimits and degree-zero complexes, yielding a system to which complex cohomology continuity applies with lower bound zero. The canonical cohomology comparison is the map identified in the first step. Injectivity of the comparison and the filtered abelian-group colimit equality criterion kill each representative at a later stage. Its sheafification image is zero and eK carries this to the asserted stage section.

Generate the sieve R by these cover members. An arrow in R factors through a member. Restrict that member's eventual-zero equality and use naturality of K.map to obtain the same equality for the composite arrow. Thus every arrow of the covering sieve has a later zero witness. No compactness or synchronization of the witnesses is used.

A higher direct image section killed at the inverse limit is killed locally on a covering sieve at later stages

theorem exists_higherDirectImage_local_section_eq_zero {S : Scheme.{v}}
    {I : Type v} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Over S)
    [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f).left]
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiCompact (D.obj i).hom]
    [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparated (D.obj i).hom]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit ((Over.forget S).mapCone c))
    [QuasiCompact c.pt.hom] [QuasiSeparated c.pt.hom]
    (F : ∀ i : I, Sheaf (D.obj (op i)).left.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (φ : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j),
      (((D.map f.op).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).obj (F i) ⟶ F j)
    (hφid : ∀ i : I, HEq (φ (𝟙 i))
      ((upperStarId AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D.obj (op i)).left).hom.app (F i)))
    (hφcomp : ∀ {i j k : I} (f : i ⟶ j) (g : j ⟶ k), HEq (φ (f ≫ g))
      ((upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (D.map g.op).left
          (D.map f.op).left).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (((D.map g.op).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).map (φ f) ≫ φ g))
    (H : I ⥤ Sheaf c.pt.left.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (eH : ∀ i : I, H.obj i ≅
      (((c.π.app (op i)).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).obj (F i))
    (hH : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), H.map f =
      (eH i).hom ≫
        (upperStarComp AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (c.π.app (op j)).left (D.map f.op).left
          (c.π.app (op i)).left
          (congrArg (fun t => t.left) (c.w f.op)).symm).hom.app (F i) ≫
        (((c.π.app (op j)).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).map (φ f) ≫ (eH j).inv)
    [HasColimit H] (p : ℕ)
    (K : I ⥤ Sheaf S.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (eK : ∀ i : I, K.obj i ≅
      (DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ (p : ℤ)).obj
        (R+(((D.obj (op i)).hom)_*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (F i))))
    (hK : ∀ {i j : I} (f : i ⟶ j), K.map f =
      (eK i).hom ≫ abelianHigherDirectImageMap (D.map f.op).left
        (D.obj (op i)).hom (D.obj (op j)).hom (Over.w (D.map f.op)) p
        (F i) (F j) (φ f) ≫ (eK j).inv)
    (η : K ⟶ (Functor.const I).obj
      ((DerivedCategory.Plus.homologyFunctor _ (p : ℤ)).obj
        (R+((c.pt.hom)_*[AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}]).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (colimit H)))))
    (hη : ∀ i : I, η.app i = (eK i).hom ≫
      abelianHigherDirectImageMap (c.π.app (op i)).left (D.obj (op i)).hom c.pt.hom
        (Over.w (c.π.app (op i))) p (F i) (colimit H)
        ((eH i).inv ≫ colimit.ι H i)) (V : S.Etale) :
    ∀ (i : I) (z : (K.obj i).obj.obj (op V)),
      (η.app i).hom.app (op V) z = 0 →
      ∃ R : Sieve V, R ∈ S.smallEtaleTopology V ∧
        ∀ (W : S.Etale) (q : W ⟶ V), R q →
          ∃ (j : I) (f : i ⟶ j),
            (K.map f).hom.app (op W) ((K.obj i).obj.map q.op z) = 0
